verdict.rationale: The CDP docs cover the core of this story. Offramp converts crypto into fiat and deposits it to bank accounts. Custodial accounts can auto-liquidate incoming stablecoins to USD and send fiat out over named ACH, Fedwire, Swift and SEPA rails, and payouts to bank accounts come with upfront fee quotes and lifecycle tracking. missing for 10: a published list of supported payout currencies and countries, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the off-ramp working in practice.
